package.description: Closes automatic ad tabs and popups in a dedicated Chrome window while keeping the tabs you opened.

en-US.description: Closes automatic ad tabs and popups in a dedicated Chrome window while keeping the tabs you opened.
en-US.longDescription:
TabBouncer watches a dedicated Chrome window through the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
It compares the link you clicked with each new tab, closes side-effect ad tabs and popups,
and returns the current tab when a page script redirects it to another site.
en-US.name: TabBouncer
